method: One-step-ahead CPI target after latest actual CPI month; AR-MIDAS uses the latest actual monthly CPI lag and 12 weekly Brent log returns when available.
evaluation_note: Historical scores use source release timestamps when present; absent CPI timestamps use NSO's actual issue date with a conservative next-Vietnam-day availability proxy, then a day-15 fallback; absent Brent release dates use observation date plus one UTC day. Source revisions are not archived, so scores are pseudo-vintage diagnostics and not real-time performance claims.
availability_policy: Live CPI labels and Brent observations are filtered by pipeline available_at; the available_at_basis fields identify whether this is a source release, Kafka timestamp, Bronze ingest, or source ingest time. Historical source vintages are not archived.
active_model_policy: Fixed AR-MIDAS remains the production estimate; validation-selected AR-MIDAS is benchmark-only and is not automatically promoted.
